title: Keep the index of the largest price
description: You use one saved index to retrieve both a snack name and its price.

steps.description: You initialize biggest to an index and visit each index in prices. biggest identifies the priciest snack seen so far.

steps.question: Does biggest store a price or an index after its assignment?
steps.answer: It stores i, the current index. prices[biggest] retrieves the price at that saved position.

steps.description: You replace the saved index only when the current price exceeds its price. The strict comparison keeps the saved index when prices tie.
You use biggest in both parallel lists to print the matching name and price. The supplied recording identifies Trail Mix at $3.25.
